Overview

Portalegre is a city in Alentejo with a population of 15,000. A historic city near the Spanish border, known for its tapestry industry, hilltop castle, and scenic Serra de São Mamede. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
